newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita to launch FIM 2 billion bonds.
newsitem.headline: Merita to launch FIM 2 billion bonds.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy said on Thursday it would launch a two billion markka bond programme.
"The bonds to be issued within the programme can have a total nominal value of up to two billion markka," Merita said in a statement.
The first two bonds would be issued on May 26, Merita said.
One would be a four-year bond with a fixed-rate coupon of 4.25 percent, and the other a six-year bond with a fixed-rate coupon of 5.00 percent, Merita said.
The maximum total value of both bonds would be 150 million markka, and the subscription period would be May 26 to August 29, it said.
Neither bond would be guaranteed, it said.
The programme can also include other than fixed-coupon bonds linked, for instance, to the Helsinki interbank Helibor interest rate or some other benchmark rate, it said. @

The instruments to be issued could be either bonds with the same debt priority as the issuer's other non-guaranteed commitments, or debentures with a lower priority than the issuer's other debt, it said.
As a general rule, the bonds issued within the programme would be listed on the Helsinki stock exchange, but the programme could also include bonds for which no listing would be sought, Merita said.
